blocks.pt: Sou game designer, e escrevo uma newsletter (baptixta.substack.com). Atualmente estou dando aulas no curso de Jogos Digitais na FIAP.
blocks.en: I'm a game designer, and I write a newsletter (baptixta.substack.com). I'm currently teaching in the Game Dev program at FIAP.

blocks.pt: Além disso, sou cofundador do Nano Knight Studio, e atuo como systems designer na Kluge Interactive. Também tenho um curso onde te ensino game design, o Game Design Experience.
blocks.en: In addition, I'm the co-founder of Nano Knight Studio, and also work as a systems designer in Kluge Interactive. I also run a course where I teach game design — Game Design Experience.

blocks.pt: Antes da Dumativa e FIAP, trabalhei na Flux Games no game design dos inimigos e chefões do jogo Cobra Kai 2: Dojos Rising.
blocks.en: Before working at Dumativa and FIAP, I was at Flux Games, designing enemies and bosses for the game Cobra Kai 2: Dojos Rising.

blocks.pt: Antes da Flux Games, trabalhei no game/level design do jogo Avalon Vivo Keyd.
blocks.en: Before Flux Games, I worked on the game and level design for Avalon Vivo Keyd.

blocks.pt: Antes disso trabalhei como Front-End Developer na FIAP, desenvolvendo e iterando o site e sistemas da empresa.
blocks.en: Before that, I worked as a Front-End Developer at FIAP, developing and iterating on the company's website and systems.
